text:
Maya: Heads up — priority intake: bringing up zephyr-lite-7B-int4 for smoke perf + quant runs. Need quick throughput/latency baseline vs baseline-mistral-7B.
Jude: +1. Proposed order: 1) int4 smoke, 2) int8 fallback, 3) ctx sweep @ [512,1024,2048], 4) batching profile (1,2,4,8,16).
Evan: Add quality check: evalset/basic-chat-100 + bertscore/bleu. If quality_delta > 0.03 flag for investigation.
Ria: I can run the perf harness. Which hw do we want to target first — p4d for max throughput or a40 for Dedicated sim?
Maya: Start on a40 (dedicated sim) to reduce variance. We'll still run p4d later to characterize peak. Record kernel selection & model.variant tags.
Ria: Copying commands I'll use:
```bash
./run_perf.py --model zephyr-lite-7b --quant int4 --batch-sizes 1,2,4,8,16 --ctx 512,1024,2048 --hw a40 --warmup 50 --iters 500 --output results/zephyr-int4-smoke.json
```
Ria: Also adding tail latency flags: `--p95 --p99 --concurrency 16` to capture SLO-relevant tails.
ops-bot: deploy job zephyr-int4-smoke-1793154820 -> started on node a40-12 (image: redwood/runtime:v2.6)
Jude: For chat-like sequences enable KV cache warmup. Suggest `prefix_cache=true` for ctx >= 1024 to get realistic steady-state throughput.
Evan: Quick quant eval snippet:
```python
# run evals with same RNG to compare quant levels
python eval.py --model zephyr-lite-7b --quant int4 --seed 42 --evalset basic-chat-100 --metrics bertscore,bleu --out out/int4_eval.json
python eval.py --model zephyr-lite-7b --quant int8 --seed 42 --evalset basic-chat-100 --metrics bertscore,bleu --out out/int8_eval.json
```
Ria: Will emit CSV with: hw,quant,batch,ctx,throughput,tok_per_sec,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,quality_delta,kernels.
Maya: Target thresholds to decide promote->pilot: throughput >= baseline*0.85 for int4; p95 < 250ms for batch<=4 at ctx=512; quality_delta < 0.03 (bert/bleu combined).
Evan: If int4 fails quality but int8 passes, mark for quant-calibration + small retrain/ptq. We'll tag the model `needs-quant-calibration`.
Ria: Kicking off int4 smoke now, will paste preliminary numbers in thread. ETA ~12m.
Ria: PRELIM: int4 @ a40, batch=1, ctx=512 -> throughput=320 tok/s, p50=75ms, p95=180ms, quality_delta=0.012 (vs baseline-mistral-7b fp16). Kernels: cuda_fused_attention_v3, matmul_fused_v2.
Maya: Nice :tada: Save logs + `kernel.profile` dump and tag the job with `variant:int4-smoke`.
Ria: Uploaded results to s3://redwood-perf/zephyr/1793154820/zephyr-int4-smoke.json and logs to s3://redwood-perf/zephyr/1793154820/logs/
Jude: Next experiments: run batch plateau sweep to find throughput knee (batch 1..32) and a concurrency sweep at fixed batch=8 to measure p99 behavior under load.
Ria: Will run concurrency sweep + int8 runs after these. Also running cold-start sequences to quantify KV-cache miss penalty (simulate empty cache then long chat).
Maya: Great. @Evan please review eval results and sign off for promoting to dedicated pilot once the thresholds are met. Add any regression notes to the onboarding ticket.
Evan: Will review in ~30m and post a short summary.
Ria: Quick note: observed soft-fallback to slower kernel at ctx=2048 for int4 on a40 — adding kernel traces to the results.
Maya: Noted, add to model onboarding checklist under "kernel regressions". If fallback causes >20% throughput drop vs fp16 baseline we block.
Ria: Updated checklist here: s3://redwood-perf/zephyr/1793154820/checklist.txt (includes perf, eval, logs, kernel.profile, SLO checks).
Maya: Thanks team — thumbs up if no blockers.
Jude: :thumbsup:
Evan: :+1:
Ria: :rocket:
